name: Azad Engineering Limited
summary: Azad Engineering Limited manufactures and sells precision-engineered components for energy and power generation, aerospace and defence, and oil and gas industries in India and internationally. It offers fixed air foil, last stage air foil rotary, welding chamfers, last stage air foil stationary, stator and rotor air foils, compressor air foils, hot gas parts, slips, drill bits, hatch cover, bonnet, and frame. The company also provides unison rings, arm, levers, assembly, body, housing, compressor and mount, valve body, butterfly plate, seal, shaft and bearing rod, piston plate and sealing ring, actuator, cover and housing, guide, poppet, tees and elbows, nipples and adaptors, aft and fore en…
